column1: birthday|/ˈbɜːθdeɪ/|节日文化|n. 生日|We eat a cake and sing on her birthday at home.|我们在家吃蛋糕唱歌庆她生日。
christmas|/ˈkrɪsməs/|节日文化|n. 圣诞节|We put gifts under the tree at christmas time.|圣诞节我们把礼物放树下。
reunion|/riˈjuːniən/|节日文化|n. 团聚|The family has a happy reunion at the spring festival.|春节一家人在团圆很开心。
parade|/pəˈreɪd/|节日文化|n. 游行|A loud parade walks down the street on the holiday.|假日一支喧闹游行走过街道。
plant|/plɑːnt/|环保|v. 种植|We plant a small tree near the lake every year.|我们每年在湖边种一棵小树。
ocean|/ˈəʊʃn/|环保|n. 海洋|The blue ocean is home to many fish and whales.|蓝色海洋是许多鱼和鲸的家。
leaf|/liːf/|环保|n. 树叶|The green leaf falls from the tree in the autumn wind.|绿叶在秋风中从树上飘落。
oxygen|/ˈɒksɪdʒən/|环保|n. 氧气|Trees give us fresh oxygen to breathe every day.|树木每天给我们新鲜氧气呼吸。
sick|/sɪk/|健康|adj. 生病的|The sick boy stays in bed and drinks warm water.|生病男孩卧床喝温水。
cough|/kɒf/|健康|v. 咳嗽|He begins to cough after he plays in the cold wind.|他在冷风中玩后开始咳嗽。
fever|/ˈfiːvə(r)/|健康|n. 发烧|The child has a fever and rests at home today.|孩子发烧今天在家休息。
wash|/wɒʃ/|健康|v. 洗|We wash our hands before we eat the meal.|我们饭前洗手。
architect|/ˈɑːkɪtekt/|理想职业|n. 建筑师|The architect draws a tall building with blue pens.|建筑师用蓝笔画高楼。
actor|/ˈæktə(r)/|理想职业|n. 演员|The actor plays a brave soldier in the film.|演员在电影里演勇敢士兵。
vet|/vet/|理想职业|n. 兽医|The vet helps a sick dog at the animal hospital.|兽医在动物医院帮病狗。
painter|/ˈpeɪntə(r)/|理想职业|n. 画家|The painter makes a pretty picture of the red flower.|画家画了红花的漂亮画。
satellite|/ˈsætəlaɪt/|科普|n. 卫星|The satellite flies around the earth in the sky.|卫星在天上绕地球飞。
gravity|/ˈɡrævəti/|科普|n. 重力|Gravity pulls the red apple down to the ground.|重力把红苹果拉到地上。
magnet|/ˈmæɡnət/|科普|n. 磁铁|The magnet picks up small iron nails on the desk.|磁铁吸起桌上小铁钉。
solar|/ˈsəʊlə(r)/|科普|adj. 太阳的|The solar panel gets power from the bright sun.|太阳能板从明亮太阳获电。
cell|/sel/|科普|n. 细胞；电池|The small cell is the unit of every living thing.|小细胞是每种生物的单位。
money|/ˈmʌni/|社会|n. 钱|We save our money to buy books at the shop.|我们存钱在小店买书。
group|/ɡruːp/|社会|n. 群体；组|Our group cleans the park after the school day.|我们组放学后打扫公园。
rule|/ruːl/|社会|n. 规则|We follow the school rule and line up at noon.|我们遵守校规中午排队。
government|/ˈɡʌvənmənt/|社会|n. 政府|The government builds a new hospital in the town.|政府在镇上建新医院。
buy|/baɪ/|高频动词|v. 买|We buy fresh fruit at the market near the school.|我们在学校附近市场买新鲜水果。
meet|/miːt/|高频动词|v. 遇见|I meet my friend at the bus stop after school.|放学后我在公交站遇见朋友。
throw|/θrəʊ/|高频动词|v. 扔|He likes to throw the ball to his little dog.|他喜欢把球扔给小狗。
show|/ʃəʊ/|高频动词|v. 展示|She shows her drawing to the teacher in class.|她课上把画展示给老师。
blow|/bləʊ/|高频动词|v. 吹|The wind begins to blow the leaves off the tree.|风开始把叶子吹离树。
